description: Rijkswaterstaat and University of Twente researchers publish monitoring data for the artificial side channels at Gameren. Bed levels cover 1996 to 2018, discharge measurements cover 2000 to 2002, and sediment samples were collected in 2017 and 2018. A hydrodynamic model computes conditions in the channels. The resource supports analysis of channel intervention dynamics. Coverage: 1996/2018 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: CSV tables, KML geographic files and plain text; ZIP and 7z archives package the files. Licence: CC0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The periods differ by measurement variable. Field-data quality and hydrodynamic calculations were not independently reproduced. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
